**Broadcast ID**: `dispatch_sol_001` | **Anchors**: Vex (The Astronomer) & Dorian (The Living Chronicler)

> [VEX]: Good evening, Enclave! [DORIAN]: And a warm hearthside greeting from your Living Chronicler. Tonight's scroll gives equal measure to Dawn's first hammer-strike, Midday's ridge expedition, Dusk's fine craft, and our communal Feast.

Lightning geodes are at 61.4% capacity and spore luminescence is 0.61—keep your copper earthing braids clipped if you're crossing Shattered Magnetite Steppe!
